text_block_list.text: Thanks to the support of Saint Light and the others, we had a fantastic training session today as well!
It's a rare and precious opportunity. I'd love to hear more from these legendary horse girls, but—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: A conversation, you say? If so, please—come along with me.
Before I knew it, Saint Light had led me to an exceptionally luxurious dining venue!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Thou too, please. Have some more. Our discussion can wait until after. ...Shall we?
While I watched in wide-eyed astonishment as Saint Light elegantly emptied plate after plate, I still managed to hear plenty of invaluable stories.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: In that case, let's go grab a meal! Mind if we head to my regular spot?
Speed Symboli brought me to a magnificent, high-class Kaiseki restaurant...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, please make yourself at home. It isn't a place that requires so much tension. Neither the atmosphere—nor the prices, you know?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I simply have a great weakness for Japanese cuisine. No matter how much I flew around the world, that one thing never changed.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Now, let us enjoy it together. Today's soup dish is—clam, excellent! I look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Oh my! In that case... would you mind accompanying me for a meal? We can chat to our hearts' content there♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Trainer-san!! Please dig in. My absolute top recommendation—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha, your eyes went completely round, Trainer-san! Did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: But this has been a favorite of mine for ages♪ Come on, let's explode with energy together~!
